title: Chhattisgarh forecast exceeds fair-share path by 11%
body: Chhattisgarh's 2029 forecast (340.2 Mt CO₂e, +2.6%/yr) exceeds its fair-share trajectory (+0.5%/yr) by 11% — driven by power + industry.
title_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ का पूर्वानुमान उचित-हिस्सा पथ से 11% अधिक
body_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ का 2029 पूर्वानुमान (340.2 Mt CO₂e, +2.6% प्रति वर्ष) उसके उचित-हिस्सा पथ (+0.5% प्रति वर्ष) से 11% अधिक है — मुख्यतः बिजली + उद्योग के कारण।

how.formula: Fair-share CAGR = national forecast CAGR × min(national per-capita CO₂e ÷ state per-capita CO₂e, 2); excess = forecast_2029 ÷ (CO₂e_2024 × (1 + fair CAGR)^5) − 1
how.inputs: State & national CO₂e 2024; population 2024; reconciled P50 forecast 2029; national CAGR +1.66%/yr
how.source: EDGAR 2025 sector grids, downscaled to states (CO₂e, AR6 GWP-100) · CarbonScope Forecast (P50, 5-yr) · Census/MoSPI population

title: Telangana power emissions jumped 32% in 2024
body: Telangana's power CO₂e jumped 32.5% in 2024 against a 5-year average of +7.0%/yr (z = +3.2) — the largest power deviation of any state.
title_hi: तेलंगाना: बिजली उत्सर्जन 2024 में 32% उछला
body_hi: तेलंगाना का बिजली CO₂e 2024 में 32.5% उछला, जबकि पिछले 5 वर्षों का औसत +7.0% प्रति वर्ष था (z = +3.2)।

how.formula: z = (growth_latest − mean(growth over prior 5 yrs)) ÷ max(sd(growth over prior 5 yrs), 1 pp); growth = CO₂e_t ÷ CO₂e_(t−1) − 1
how.inputs: Telangana power CO₂e 2018–2024; flagged when |z| ≥ 2 (≥ 3 = warning); sector ≥ 1 Mt
how.source: EDGAR 2025 sector grids, downscaled to states (CO₂e, AR6 GWP-100)

title: Chhattisgarh has India's highest industrial emissions intensity
body: Chhattisgarh leads all states on industrial emissions intensity (27.57 MtCO₂e per ₹ lakh crore); Uttar Pradesh is lowest among high-GSDP states (2.58).
title_hi: छत्तीसगढ़: भारत में सर्वाधिक औद्योगिक उत्सर्जन तीव्रता
body_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ औद्योगिक उत्सर्जन तीव्रता में सभी राज्यों में सबसे आगे है (27.57 MtCO₂e per ₹ lakh crore); उच्च-GSDP राज्यों में उत्तर प्रदेश सबसे कम (2.58)।

how.formula: Industrial intensity = industry CO₂e (Mt) ÷ real GSDP (₹ lakh crore, 2011-12 prices)
how.inputs: 2024; states with ≥ 1 Mt in the sector and ≥ 2 M people; 'high-GSDP' = top third by real GSDP
how.source: EDGAR 2025 sector grids, downscaled to states (CO₂e, AR6 GWP-100) · MoSPI GSDP · Census population

title: Karnataka has India's highest per-capita transport emissions
body: Karnataka leads all states on per-capita transport emissions (0.71 tCO₂e per person); West Bengal is lowest among high-GSDP states (0.10).
title_hi: कर्नाटक: भारत में सर्वाधिक प्रति व्यक्ति परिवहन उत्सर्जन
body_hi: कर्नाटक प्रति व्यक्ति परिवहन उत्सर्जन में सभी राज्यों में सबसे आगे है (0.71 tCO₂e per person); उच्च-GSDP राज्यों में पश्चिम बंगाल सबसे कम (0.10)।

how.formula: Per-capita transport = transport CO₂e (t) ÷ population
how.inputs: 2024; states with ≥ 1 Mt in the sector and ≥ 2 M people; 'high-GSDP' = top third by real GSDP
how.source: EDGAR 2025 sector grids, downscaled to states (CO₂e, AR6 GWP-100) · MoSPI GSDP · Census population

title: West Bengal: power decoupling for 2 straight years
body: West Bengal's real GSDP grew 16% over 2022–2024 while power CO₂e fell 2% — 2 consecutive years of absolute decoupling.
title_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल: लगातार 2 वर्षों से बिजली डीकपलिंग
body_hi: 2022–2024 में पश्चिम बंगाल का वास्तविक GSDP 16% बढ़ा जबकि बिजली CO₂e 2% घटा — लगातार 2 वर्ष पूर्ण डीकपलिंग।

how.formula: Absolute decoupling year: GSDP_t > GSDP_(t−1) AND CO₂e_t < CO₂e_(t−1); streak counted back from the latest year. Index_t = value_t ÷ value_2019 × 100
how.inputs: Real GSDP (2011-12 ₹, MoSPI; imputed years excluded) and power CO₂e
how.source: EDGAR 2025 sector grids, downscaled to states (CO₂e, AR6 GWP-100) · MoSPI GSDP

title: What drives Andaman and Nicobar Islands' forecast
body: Top 3 sector drivers of Andaman and Nicobar Islands' 2024→2029 forecast change: transport (+59 kt), power (+30 kt), agriculture (+10 kt).
title_hi: अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीपसमूह के पूर्वानुमान के मुख्य कारक

how.formula: Δ_sector = forecast P50_2029 (reconciled) − observed CO₂e_2024; ranked by |Δ|

title: Delhi vs Chhattisgarh: 12× per-capita gap
body: Delhi's per-capita CO₂e is 0.85 t — about 1/12 of Chhattisgarh's 9.8 t (India average 2.99 t, 2024).

title: National power emissions intensity -17% since 2015
body: India's power CO₂e per unit of real GDP changed -16.7% between 2015 and 2024 (-2.0%/yr, decoupling).
title_hi: राष्ट्रीय बिजली उत्सर्जन तीव्रता 2015 से -17%
body_hi: 2015 से 2024 के बीच भारत की बिजली CO₂e प्रति इकाई वास्तविक GDP -16.7% बदली (-2.0% प्रति वर्ष)।

how.formula: Intensity_t = Σ_states sector CO₂e_t ÷ Σ_states real GSDP_t; CAGR = (I_end ÷ I_2015)^(1/n) − 1
how.inputs: National totals 2005–2024
how.source: EDGAR 2025 sector grids, downscaled to states (CO₂e, AR6 GWP-100) · MoSPI GSDP

title: Grid emission factor +2% since FY2017
body: CEA plant data: the conventional fleet's average emission factor moved from 0.822 to 0.835 tCO₂/MWh (FY2017→FY2024). Solar/wind are outside the CEA baseline database, so this understates the all-source decline.
title_hi: ग्रिड उत्सर्जन कारक FY2017 से +2%
body_hi: CEA संयंत्र आंकड़े: पारंपरिक बिजली संयंत्रों का औसत उत्सर्जन कारक 0.822 से 0.835 tCO₂/MWh (FY2017→FY2024)।

how.formula: GEF_t = Σ plant CO₂_t ÷ Σ plant net generation_t (grid-connected coal, gas, oil, hydro, nuclear)
how.inputs: CEA CO₂ Baseline Database v22, FY2017–FY2024 (FY t–t+1 → year t)
how.source: CEA CO₂ Baseline Database
